item.text: {"action":"experiment","hypothesis":"L020 showed that hist_gradient_boosting/raw fallback for fe_anion worsened every reported aggregate relative to L007, while L010 showed that changing an explicitly specialized fe_anion expert from extra_trees/raw to extra_trees/log1p improved pooled MAE relative to A01 despite a positive-Tc tradeoff. Combining L007's near-incumbent other-route hist_gradient_boosting/raw expert with the localized fe_anion extra_trees/log1p target may recover enough fe_anion error to improve pooled MAE while retaining L007's guard margin.","falsification":"The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted training OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K (at least 0.01 K better than A05) and positive-Tc MAE is at most the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Improvements confined to reported-zero, high-Tc, or an individual route without both conditions are subgroup tradeoffs, not an eligible win.","reason":"The required minimum is still pending at 20 of 22 successful unique cycles.
